facts.fact: According to Omnisend's SMS marketing statistics roundup, SMS messages have a 98% open rate.
facts.quote: SMS gets opened at a rate of 98%, with 90% of messages read in three minutes or less

facts.fact: According to Omnisend's SMS marketing statistics roundup, email open rates sit at 20 to 30%.
facts.quote: email open rates sit at 20 to 30% with an average response time of 90 minutes

facts.fact: According to Emarsys, 69% of consumers prefer email as their communication channel with brands.
facts.quote: 69% of consumers prefer email as their communication channel with brands, while 43% find SMS useful

facts.fact: According to Klaviyo benchmarks, SMS flows account for 7.6% of total SMS sends.
facts.quote: SMS flows account for just 7.6% of total SMS sends but generate 45.2% of total SMS revenue

facts.fact: Per Klaviyo's data cited by the page, behavior-triggered messages achieve click rates nearing 10% on average.
facts.quote: behavior-triggered messages achieve click rates nearing 10% on average, with top performers exceeding 16%

facts.fact: According to Textbolt, TCPA regulations impose penalties of $500 to $1,500 per unsolicited SMS message (third-party claim cited by Adwave).
facts.quote: TCPA regulations impose penalties of $500 to $1,500 per unsolicited SMS message

facts.fact: According to Sinch, 75.4% of consumers expect transactional messages in five minutes or less after an interaction (third-party claim cited by Adwave).
facts.quote: 75.4% of consumers expect transactional messages in five minutes or less after an interaction
